findings.obligation: test-writing rule 6: a slow or flaky test is made smaller or deterministic, never given a longer timeout
findings.observation: Full 8-file run on 1fb9c7f9d: beforeAll hook timed out at 10000ms and the file reported no tests (15 skipped). The same file alone is green (15 passed). Load-sensitive cold import of EditConnection and SettingsAreaPage inside beforeAll.
findings.remediation: Make the warm-up deterministic: import once per module under a fake clock or mock the lazy modules, or drop the beforeAll and let the first test pay the cold import under its own budget; rerun the 8-file set green twice before close.
